artwork_status.sql: SELECT status,count(*) artworks,count(*) FILTER(WHERE primary_media_id IS NOT NULL) illustrated FROM artworks GROUP BY status ORDER BY artworks DESC

artwork_types.sql: SELECT work_type,count(*) artworks,count(*) FILTER(WHERE primary_media_id IS NOT NULL) illustrated FROM artworks WHERE status<>'archived' GROUP BY work_type ORDER BY artworks DESC

table_estimates.sql: SELECT relname,n_live_tup,n_dead_tup,n_tup_ins,n_tup_upd,n_tup_del,last_analyze,last_autoanalyze FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE relname IN('artworks','media_assets','artwork_media','audit_log','ingestion_row_audits','institutions','artwork_search_documents') ORDER BY relname

audit_columns.sql: SELECT table_name,column_name,data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND (table_name ILIKE '%audit%' OR table_name IN('institutions','media_assets','artwork_media','source_institutions')) ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position

audit_indexes.sql: SELECT tablename,indexname,indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND(tablename ILIKE '%audit%' OR tablename IN('media_assets','artworks')) ORDER BY tablename,indexname

rows.indexdef: CREATE INDEX artwork_research_review_page_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (normalized_title, id) WHERE (research_candidate AND (status = 'review'::text))
CREATE INDEX artwork_title_search_idx ON public.artworks USING gin (title gin_trgm_ops)
CREATE INDEX artworks_active_seo_id_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (id) WHERE (status <> 'archived'::text)
CREATE INDEX artworks_active_summary_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (id) INCLUDE (current_institution_id, work_type) WHERE (status <> 'archived'::text)

CREATE INDEX artworks_atlas_illustrated_identity_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (id) INCLUDE (creation_year_start, creation_year_end, primary_media_id, work_type, cultural_context) WHERE ((status <> 'archived'::text) AND (primary_media_id IS NOT NULL) AND (date_precision = ANY (ARRAY['exact'::text, 'circa'::text, 'range'::text, 'circa_range'::text, 'decade'::text, 'century'::text])) AND (artline_creation_scope(creation_year_start, creation_year_end, date_precision) = 'eligible'::text) AND (COALESCE(creation_year_start, creation_year_end) <> 0) AND (COALESCE(creation_year_end, creation_year_start) <> 0))

CREATE INDEX artworks_atlas_illustrated_native_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (COALESCE(creation_year_start, creation_year_end), id) INCLUDE (creation_year_start, creation_year_end, status, date_precision, primary_media_id, work_type, cultural_context) WHERE ((status <> 'archived'::text) AND (primary_media_id IS NOT NULL) AND (date_precision = ANY (ARRAY['exact'::text, 'circa'::text, 'range'::text, 'circa_range'::text, 'decade'::text, 'century'::text])) AND (artline_creation_scope(creation_year_start, creation_year_end, date_precision) = 'eligible'::text) AND (COALESCE(creation_year_start, creation_year_end) <> 0) AND (COALESCE(creation_year_end, creation_year_start) <> 0))
CREATE INDEX artworks_directory_media_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (primary_media_id) WHERE ((status <> 'archived'::text) AND (primary_media_id IS NOT NULL))
CREATE INDEX artworks_directory_title_id_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (normalized_title, id) WHERE (status <> 'archived'::text)

CREATE INDEX artworks_directory_undated_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (normalized_title, id) WHERE ((status <> 'archived'::text) AND (creation_year_start IS NULL) AND (creation_year_end IS NULL))
CREATE INDEX artworks_institution_accession_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (current_institution_id, accession_number, id) WHERE (accession_number IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX artworks_institution_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (current_institution_id, status, id)
CREATE INDEX artworks_institution_year_page_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (current_institution_id, creation_year_start, normalized_title, id) WHERE (status <> 'archived'::text)

CREATE INDEX artworks_museum_card_covering_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (current_institution_id, status, id) INCLUDE (title, creation_year_start, primary_media_id, unlinked_creator_label) WHERE (status <> 'archived'::text)

CREATE INDEX artworks_museum_gallery_covering_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (current_institution_id, status, id) INCLUDE (normalized_title, creation_year_start, creation_year_end, primary_media_id, unlinked_creator_label, work_type) WHERE (status <> 'archived'::text)

CREATE INDEX artworks_museum_illustrated_cover_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (current_institution_id, creation_year_start, title, id) INCLUDE (primary_media_id) WHERE ((status <> 'archived'::text) AND (primary_media_id IS NOT NULL))

CREATE INDEX artworks_museum_image_title_seek_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (current_institution_id, normalized_title, id) INCLUDE (primary_media_id) WHERE ((status <> 'archived'::text) AND (primary_media_id IS NOT NULL))

CREATE INDEX artworks_museum_title_seek_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (current_institution_id, normalized_title, id) INCLUDE (primary_media_id, creation_year_start, creation_year_end, work_type) WHERE (status <> 'archived'::text)

CREATE INDEX artworks_painting_directory_seek_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (normalized_title, id) INCLUDE (primary_media_id, creation_year_start, creation_year_end) WHERE ((status <> 'archived'::text) AND (work_type = 'painting'::text))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX artworks_pkey ON public.artworks USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX artworks_primary_media_lookup_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (primary_media_id, id) WHERE (primary_media_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX artworks_published_seo_id_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (id) WHERE (status = 'published'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX artworks_slug_key ON public.artworks USING btree (slug)
CREATE INDEX artworks_unlinked_creator_search_idx ON public.artworks USING gin (unlinked_creator_label gin_trgm_ops) WHERE ((status <> 'archived'::text) AND (unlinked_creator_label IS NOT NULL))
CREATE INDEX idx_artworks_status_creation_year ON public.artworks USING btree (status, creation_year_start)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX audit_log_pkey ON public.audit_log USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX idx_audit_log_entity_created ON public.audit_log USING btree (entity_type, entity_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX media_assets_atlas_deliverable_idx ON public.media_assets USING btree (id) WHERE (storage_path ~ '^/assets/[a-zA-Z0-9/_-]+\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|avif)$'::text)
CREATE INDEX media_assets_local_image_id_idx ON public.media_assets USING btree (id) WHERE (storage_path ~ '^/assets/[a-zA-Z0-9/_-]+\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|avif)$'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX media_assets_pkey ON public.media_assets USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX media_assets_storage_path_key ON public.media_assets USING btree (storage_path)
CREATE INDEX media_directory_local_idx ON public.media_assets USING btree (id) WHERE (storage_path ~ '^/assets/[a-zA-Z0-9/_-]+\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|avif)$'::text)

artwork_triggers.sql: SELECT c.relname,t.tgname,t.tgenabled,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) definition FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal AND c.relname IN('artworks','media_assets','institutions','artwork_media') ORDER BY c.relname,t.tgname

rouen_institutions.sql: SELECT i.*,p.name place_name,p.country_code,(SELECT count(*) FROM artworks a WHERE a.current_institution_id=i.id AND a.status<>'archived') active_artworks,(SELECT count(*) FROM artworks a WHERE a.current_institution_id=i.id AND a.status<>'archived' AND a.primary_media_id IS NOT NULL) illustrated_artworks FROM institutions i LEFT JOIN places p ON p.id=i.place_id WHERE i.name ILIKE '%rouen%' OR i.slug ILIKE '%rouen%' ORDER BY i.slug
